setup.intro: Pick a mode, the number of rounds and the music, then jump in.

ranked.title: Ranked
ranked.description: The standard set. Your score counts for the leaderboard.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: Pick your own music. Not ranked.

music.heading: Music
